Njf.description: Jezero floor unit: rugged, cratered floor unit of mafic composition, previously mapped as the 'volcanic floor unit' (USGS SIM 3464, Description of Map Units).

NHjf2.description: Jezero fan unit 2: stratified fan deposit at the mouth of Neretva Vallis, associated with Fe/Mg clay and carbonate, previously mapped as the 'western fan deposit' (USGS SIM 3464, Description of Map Units).
